---
title: "SCX"
subtitle: "Single-cell format conversion, designed for reproducible benchmarks"
toc: false
---

SCX converts single-cell datasets between formats. It reads the count matrix
as a stream of cell chunks and writes it out in another layout, so memory is
bounded by the chunk size rather than the dataset. The engine is written in
Rust and has three front ends that share its conversion semantics and
defaults:

::: {.panel-tabset group="language"}

## CLI

Install:

```bash
cargo install scx-cli
```

Start with:

```bash
scx convert in.h5seurat out.h5ad
```

## Python

Install:

```bash
pip install scx-picklerick
```

Start with:

```python
import picklerick as pk

pk.convert("in.h5seurat", "out.h5ad")
```

## R

Install (builds the engine from source, so it needs Rust's `cargo`, CMake
and a C/C++ compiler):

```r
pak::pak("btraven00/scx/r/picklerick")
```

Start with:

```r
library(picklerick)

convert("in.h5seurat", "out.h5ad")
```

:::

## Formats

| Format | Read | Write |
|---|:-:|:-:|
| AnnData `.h5ad` | ✓ | ✓ |
| AnnData Zarr (v2, v3; directory) | ✓ | ✓ (v3) |
| Seurat `.h5seurat` (dgCMatrix or BPCells-backed) | ✓ | ✓ |
| BPCells matrix directory | ✓ | ✓ X only |
| 10x HDF5 (Cell Ranger `.h5`) | ✓ | |
| MatrixMarket `.mtx[.gz]` / 10x MEX directory | ✓ | |
| Parquet, local or S3/GCS/HTTP (CLI built with `--features net`) | ✓ | |
| Seurat `.rds` / `.rda` (counts and `meta.data`; v3/v4 `Assay`, v5 `Assay5`) | ✓ | |
| bixverse binary sparse store, v3 and v4 (CLI built with `--features bixverse`) | ✓ | |

Any readable format converts to any writable one: everything goes through a
single internal representation. The input format is detected from the
content; the output format from the extension (`.h5ad`, `.h5seurat`,
`.zarr`, `.bpcells`).
